# Synthetic author notes for blog-post evaluation

This fictional fixture tests rewriting and is not evidence about a real person or book club.

I run a small book club. Last month I sent discussion questions two days before our meeting instead of at the start. Five of our eight members said that helped them prepare. I do not know whether it changed who spoke during the meeting. My takeaway: I will send questions early again, but I would not claim it makes everyone participate.
